title: The guard against the owner's morning: no guessed outcome, a list of cases recognised
request: The owner tested anomaly detection on the product and it did not understand the problem: the target was customer_id, not the fake deliveries. Double-check, find the cause, and make DCLab stop building the wrong thing.
spec: An identifier, a constant, a row number, a counter or free text is never an outcome; nothing picks the outcome for the person (not the wizard, the page, the chat's options or the intern); a table that is a list of known cases is recognised, pointed at the table it labels, and not built alone; the model may ask any open field of its draft once the outcome is raised. Done when the owner's morning, replayed on the invented delivery-fraud replica, cannot end in a project on a key, and a real labelled table named fraud still builds.
plan: Read the records of the owner's morning (structure and the agent's words only, nothing from the data into the repository).
Trace where customer_id came from: the profile's ranking, the wizard's fallback, the page's preselection.
Put one rule in the graph's set_solution check so every path gets it; mirror it in the draft's wizard.
Recognise a list of cases by its shape, look for the table it labels in the workspace's other drafts.
Let the model ask what it judges useful, inside the outcome-first rule.
Review, plant every fault, fix the tests that could not fail.

decisions.decision: The outcome is never guessed; the person or the chat names it.
decisions.why: A column picked for having few values became the target and five stages ran on it without objection.

decisions.decision: Numbers different on every row are refused only when they count 1, 2, 3, are named as a key, or are text.
decisions.why: Whole-number salaries and prices are as distinct as keys and are real regression targets.

decisions.decision: A list of cases needs every row in one state; its file name alone is not enough, and a column that reads as an outcome makes it a table to learn from.
decisions.why: A labelled transactions table named fraud was refused as a list of cases.

decisions.decision: Messages that reach the model's history carry names and counts, not values.
decisions.why: The Home agent's contract sends no cell value to a model.

decisions.decision: The outcome comes first; after it the plan's order is a suggestion.
decisions.why: The model's own questions (which anomalies matter, what is done with a flag) were refused for the order that morning.

decisions.decision: Naming an outcome lets a person build a list of cases if they mean to.
decisions.why: The guard refuses guesses, not a person's choice.

change: dclab_rnd/studio/data.py (target_refusal, proposable_target, key_named, sequence_like), dclab_rnd/studio/graph.py (Target can be an outcome), dclab_rnd/studio/labels.py (cases_table, tables_it_labels), dclab_rnd/draft/pipeline.py, dclab_rnd/draft/chat.py (rank_targets, the cases message, the ask guard), dclab_rnd/draft/api.py (proposal, draft solution, BuildRefused), dclab_rnd/intern/loop.py, dclab_rnd/agentic/web/src/views/new.html and solution.html, tests/test_morning_guard.py.

findings.defect: A list of known frauds was built into a project whose target was customer_id.
findings.scenario: The owner's two challenge files in two drafts; the frauds' draft built with target customer_id (3 values), task multiclass, all stages completed.
findings.cause: Candidates ranked few values first; the wizard and the page took the first candidate; nothing refused a key; nothing recognised a list of cases.
findings.fix: No guessed outcome anywhere; one refusal rule in the graph; the list of cases recognised and pointed at the orders.

findings.defect: The model's right questions were refused by the fixed order.
findings.scenario: Asked what kind of unusual case and what is done with a flag: 'The plan does not ask about target now'.
findings.cause: The guard required the plan's next field.
findings.fix: Any open field of the draft once the outcome is raised.

findings.defect: A key repeated by multi-drop orders passed the key rule.
findings.scenario: order_id with 98 % distinct values was allowed as a target by the graph.
findings.fix: A key-named column over half distinct is a key.

findings.defect: A synthetic card-fraud table was refused as a list of cases.
findings.scenario: Its name said fraud, it had an id and a category column.
findings.fix: Every row in one state is required; no outcome-like column.

findings.scenario: The order test passed under the old rule; labels was not a guarded field.
findings.cause: The test asked a field outside the guard.
findings.fix: The morning's own refused question (action) is replayed.

findings.defect: Without its first-candidate guess, the intern's standard plan stopped on a table whose column is named target.
findings.scenario: The judgment suite's standard policy: 0 of 13 leaks, no valid moves.
findings.cause: Removing the guess removed the table's own declaration with it.
findings.fix: named_outcome: a column the person named in their request, or one the table names as its outcome (target, label, outcome); a key is never named.

findings.defect: The chat still offered key columns as likely outcomes.
findings.scenario: delivery_id and biker_id were the question's first options.
findings.cause: rank_targets used its own looser filter.
findings.fix: One proposable_target rule for the profile, the chat and the page.

findings.defect: Whole-number regression targets were refused as keys.
findings.scenario: salary and rounded price: 'is a key, not an outcome'.
findings.cause: Any 98 % distinct integer column was id-like.
findings.fix: Refused only as a counter, a key name, or text.

findings.defect: A labelled table named fraud could never be built.
findings.scenario: fraud_transactions.csv with chargeback 0/1 and transaction_type: refused, no override.
findings.cause: File name enough; outcome exemption by name only.
findings.fix: Every row in one state required; a two-valued outcome-like column exempts; naming an outcome overrides.

findings.scenario: The cases' reason column renamed fraud_reason counted as the outcome.
findings.fix: A kind of case is never the outcome.

findings.defect: Cell values reached the model's history.
findings.scenario: final_status = DELIVERED and the kinds of case were in the analysis message.
findings.fix: Names and counts only; no other draft's problem text.

findings.defect: The intern still picked the first candidate.
findings.scenario: A project with data and no suggestion handed to the intern.
findings.cause: Its standard plan fell back to target_candidates[0].
findings.fix: It asks the person to name the outcome.

findings.defect: The project's solution editor selected the first column.
findings.scenario: Edit the solution on a project without one: cols[0] preselected and saved.
findings.fix: A blank 'choose the outcome column' option.

findings.defect: Binary outcomes ending in id were no longer offered.
findings.scenario: is_paid, valid, covid matched the wide key pattern.
findings.fix: A strict key_named pattern for this rule.

findings.defect: The search for the labelled table could name a stale file or fail the upload.
findings.scenario: Every table of a draft is cleaned into one file; a database error fell into the pipeline's catch-all.
findings.fix: Each draft's active table only; any error returns nothing.

findings.defect: The relaxed guard accepted another pack's fields.
findings.scenario: A generic draft asked about an alert budget.
findings.fix: Only the draft's own or the generic fields.

measurements.name: planted faults
measurements.gate: each of the 12 planted faults in the guard fails a test
measurements.result: 12 of 12 caught after strengthening 3 tests that first could not fail
limits: Only the faults planted; the browser does not run the page change.

measurements.name: scripted judgment suite after the guard
measurements.gate: every policy's scorecard equal to AEV-019's
measurements.result: AEV-020: standard 1/13 leaks, 1/20 false alarms; audit 11/13, 3/20; bad 0/13, unsafe refused 20/20: equal
limits: Scripted policies on planted traps only.

outcome: The morning cannot repeat: no outcome is guessed, a key cannot be one, a list of cases is recognised and pointed at its table; a person's choice still stands.
lessons: Read the session's records before guessing: the cause was the rules, not the model.
One rule in the check every path passes; every surface that offers choices uses the same rule.
A guard that refuses real targets is a new bug: plant the legitimate cases next to the bad ones.
Detect a shape by what it lacks as well as what it has: a list of cases has no outcome of its own.
A test that passes under the old code proves nothing: plant the old rule back.
Text the model reads must keep the model's data contract.
risks: A model trained on a key.
A list of cases built alone.
